_source.title: 获取 PCB 制版文件（Gerber）
_source.remarks.text.0: 可以使用 {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} 接口将文件导出到本地文件系统
_source.params.colorSilkscreen: 是否生成彩色丝印制造文件（嘉立创专用文件）
_source.params.layers: 导出层，默认则按照嘉立创生产需求导出
_source.params.objects: 导出对象，默认则按照嘉立创生产需求导出

title: Get the PCB fabrication file (Gerber)
remarks.text.0: You can use {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} API export the file to the local file system
params.colorSilkscreen: Whether to generate a color silkscreen fabrication file (EasyEDA-specific file)
params.layers: Exported layers. By default, they are exported according to EasyEDA production requirements
params.objects: Exported objects. By default, they are exported according to EasyEDA production requirements
